get.summary: Readiness: database and Redis are reachable
Look up a product by barcode
get.description: Barcode: EAN-8, UPC-A (returned as EAN-13), EAN-13 or GTIN-14, with a valid check digit. Served from the cache or our database; unknown barcodes are looked up on Open Food Facts, stored and scored.

503.description: Not stored, and Open Food Facts is unavailable; retry later

get.description: Products of the same kind (Nutri-Score category and shared Open Food Facts food categories) with a strictly better grade, closest nutrient profile first. Reads our database only; the product must have been looked up before. A product without a grade has no alternatives (empty list).

422.description: Not a valid barcode, or limit out of range

post.description: Scanning needs no account; contributing does. Signs the new user in.

422.description: Invalid email, or password shorter than 10 characters

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for new tokens
post.description: Each refresh token works once. Presenting one again signs out every device that shares its session (the token was probably copied).
Revokes the refresh token's session. Always succeeds.

post.summary: Get a URL to upload a contribution photo
post.description: Returns a presigned URL for one `PUT` of the photo, valid for a few minutes. The upload must send exactly the declared `Content-Type` and `Content-Length`; storage rejects anything else. JPEG or PNG, up to the server's size limit.

422.description: Not JPEG or PNG, too large, or an invalid request

post.description: A product from label photos, as reviewed by the contributor. Upload the photos first (`POST /v1/uploads`, same `client_id`). Stored as `pending` until a moderator decides. Sending the same `client_id` again returns the stored contribution (200).

422.description: Invalid barcode or values, or photos not uploaded by this user

get.description: The signed-in user's contributions with their moderation status.

404.description: No such contribution of this user

post.summary: Read nutrition values from a label's OCR text
post.description: Rule-based parser (French, English, Arabic): values per 100 g or 100 mL, the basis, and issues (missing values, a table declared per portion only, values failing the sanity checks). When that reading is not ok and the LLM fallback is enabled, `fallback` holds a request for it: poll `GET /v1/labels/parse/{id}`. Only the OCR text is sent to the LLM. The contributor reviews the values either way; nothing else is stored.

get.summary: The LLM fallback's reading of a label
get.description: `pending` until the worker has read it (ask again every second or two), then `done` with values that passed the same checks as the rule-based parser's, or `needs_manual_entry` with the reason. Given up as `timeout` when not done in time.

404.description: No such request of this user

post.description: The grade and breakdown the server's engine gives these values, e.g. while a contributor reviews a label. Nothing is stored.

post.summary: Report an error on a product
post.description: No account needed; the user is recorded when a valid token is sent. Sending the same `client_id` again is acknowledged (200) without storing it twice.

422.description: Invalid report (no reason, `other` without a comment, ...)

get.summary: One contribution, with links to its photos

patch.description: Only the fields sent change; `nutrition` replaces all the values. The contributor's own values are kept in `submitted_values` the first time.

post.description: Creates or updates the product as verified (source `contribution`), adds the contributed nutrition as a new version, scores it and makes the front photo the product photo.
The product, if any, is left unchanged. The note is shown to the contributor.

post.summary: Mark a report resolved (the product was fixed)

AlternativeProduct.title: AlternativeProduct
AlternativeProduct.description: A product with a better grade, of the same kind (`GET .../alternatives`).

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Scoring category. Choosing it is the caller's job (see docs/specs/README.md).

ContributionEdit.title: ContributionEdit
ContributionEdit.description:
A moderator's corrections to a pending contribution; only the fields sent change.
`nutrition` replaces all the values (missing ones: not declared).

ContributionOcr.title: ContributionOcr
ContributionOcr.description: Text read from each photo on the phone.

ContributionPhotos.title: ContributionPhotos
ContributionPhotos.description: Keys returned by `POST /v1/uploads` for this contribution, once uploaded.

ContributionRead.title: ContributionRead
ContributionRead.description: A contribution as its contributor sees it.

ContributionReview.title: ContributionReview
ContributionReview.description: Everything a moderator needs to decide.

Credentials.title: Credentials
Credentials.description: Registration and login. Emails are compared lower-cased.

FallbackReason.title: FallbackReason
FallbackReason.description: Why the LLM fallback gave no values (the contributor types them).

FallbackStatus.title: FallbackStatus
FallbackStatus.description: A request to the LLM fallback parser (T28).

LabelFallbackRead.title: LabelFallbackRead
LabelFallbackRead.description: The LLM fallback parser's reading of a label, read in the background.

LabelParseResult.title: LabelParseResult
LabelParseResult.description: The rule-based parser's reading, and the LLM fallback when that one is not ok.

LabelReading.title: LabelReading
LabelReading.description: Values read from a label by one parser.

LabelValues.title: LabelValues
LabelValues.description:
Values read from the label, per 100 g or 100 mL; null: not found. Not checked
against the request limits: a value can be impossible (see `issues`).

NutritionDetail.title: NutritionDetail
NutritionDetail.description: The latest declared nutrition, per 100 g or 100 mL (`basis`). None: not declared.

NutritionValues.title: NutritionValues
NutritionValues.description: Per 100 g or 100 mL, as declared on the label; null or missing: not declared.

OverexposureRisk.title: OverexposureRisk
OverexposureRisk.description: EFSA's risk that part of the population exceeds the acceptable daily intake.

ParserUsed.title: ParserUsed
ParserUsed.description: What filled in the fields before the contributor reviewed them.

PhotoKind.title: PhotoKind
PhotoKind.description: Which side of the package a contribution photo shows.

ProductDetail.title: ProductDetail
ProductDetail.description: `GET /v1/products/{ean}`: everything the app shows for a scanned product.

QualityFlag.title: QualityFlag
QualityFlag.description: Data quality, set by the Open Food Facts normaliser (T13).

ScorePreview.title: ScorePreview
ScorePreview.description:
The score the product would get, computed by the server's engine; nothing is
saved. Same fields as a product's score.

TokenPair.title: TokenPair
TokenPair.description:
Send `access_token` as `Authorization: Bearer ...`; when it expires, exchange
`refresh_token` (single use) at `/v1/auth/refresh` for a new pair.

UploadTicket.title: UploadTicket
UploadTicket.description:
Upload the file with `PUT url`, sending exactly the requested `Content-Type` and
`Content-Length` (both are signed: storage rejects anything else). Then refer to the
photo by `key` when submitting the contribution.
